Agility begins Nasdaq trading after closing its business combination

The completed transaction brings approximately $465 million in gross capital, advancing beyond the previously announced shareholder-vote timetable.

Agility Robotics ↗5 November 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

From a vote timetable to completion

Agility announced November 5 trading on Nasdaq under AGLT and AGLTW following its completed combination with Churchill Capital Corp XI. The transaction and related financings raised approximately $465 million before expenses. This advances beyond earlier reporting about the vote timetable and estimated proceeds.

Funding commercial expansion

Proceeds are intended to support orders, deployments, Digit production and AI development. The company reports more than 65,000 operating hours and over $300 million in multi-year Digit 5 orders. Those orders remain subject to contractual milestones, product features and specifications.

Delivery targets remain prospective

Early customer access to Digit 5 is expected in the first half of 2027, with general availability targeted for late 2027. RoboFab is designed for up to 10,000 robots annually; that is design capacity, not current output. Completing the listing does not establish that all manufacturing and delivery targets have been achieved.
